name: Baleful Aura
body:
Your Aura of Misfortune becomes larger.

Prerequisites: Aura of misfortune class feature, strife pool.

Benefit: As a standard action, you can increase the area of your aura of misfortune by 10 ft. Each round your aura remains expanded, it consumes a point of strife. You may dismiss this effect as a free action.
